text.en:
The Director of the Weather Bureau shall establish at some suitable point to be selected by him
on or near the shore of Bombon Lake a seismological station for the purpose of observing and studying the
disturbances of the earth which precede the eruptions of Taal Volcano and of giving seasonable warnings to
the inhabitants concerned when there is danger that an eruption may occur.

There shall be operated in connection with said station Launch on Bombon launch which shall
be kept constantly ready and available for use in warning and assisting persons living on or near the shore of
Bombon Lake in the event of the occurrence, or likelihood, of a serious eruption. When Taal Volcano is
quiescent this launch may be employed in transporting persons and freight on Bombon Lake for hire, and the
receipts from such transportation shall be current receipts of the Weather Bureau and are hereby made
available for the maintenance of the launch and for meeting the expenses of the station.

Telephonic and telegraphic communication shall be established between the station and the
telephone and telegraph system in the Province of Batangas.

The sum of eighteen thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds m the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the purchase of a suitable launch and for its operation and
maintenance during the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and thirteen; for the acquisition of
the necessary seismological apparatus; for the purchase of a suitable building site; for the construction of the
necessary buildings; for the establishment of telephonic and telegraphic communication; and for the salaries
of one employee at seven hundred and twenty pesos per annum, one employee at four hundred and eighty
pesos per annum, and one employee at one hundred and eighty pesos per annum, hereby authorized: Provided,
That the construction of the necessary buildings and the installation of the apparatus shall be under the
direction and control of the Director of the Weather Bureau.

The scale of charges for transporting passengers and rates freight shall be fixed by the Director
of the Weather Bureau, subject to the approval of the Secretary of the Interior.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 1, 1912.
